title: Zero-Emission Heating Paradox: reproduction package
description: Code, inputs, archived solver results, and logs reproducing every number, table, and figure of 'The Zero-Emission Heating Paradox: Stochastic Planning and Operation of Electric Bus Fleets in Cold Climates'. Two-stage stochastic MILP for cold-climate battery-electric bus fleet planning with fuel-fired-heater retention, EVSE-coupled preconditioning, emissions policy, and division-scale coordination.
